Senior Backend Engineer

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own FastAPI services, PostgreSQL data modeling, and AWS infrastructure. You will improve API latency, design REST endpoints, and mentor engineers.

Requirements
- 5+ years of Python
- Strong PostgreSQL and SQL
- Experience with Docker and CI/CD
- Redis caching
- AWS
- pytest and testing culture

Nice to have
- TypeScript
- Kafka
- Kubernetes
